scope.kind: local persistent MLX JSONL application boundary

boundary_semantics.partial_or_oversize_input_action: immediately abort the worker process group without a graceful request, emit fatal stderr receipt, exit 2
boundary_semantics.unexpected_worker_or_stdout_boundary_act: immediately abort the worker process group, emit fatal stderr receipt, exit 3
boundary_semantics.ordinary_model_error_action: only generation_failed and invalid_model emit a request-correlated recoverable error and continue
boundary_semantics.expected_session_model_or_cache_error_ac: only generation_failed, invalid_model, session_cache_failed, and session_cache_limit recover after invalidating the affected session
boundary_semantics.unknown_worker_error_action: fatal stderr receipt, immediate process-group abort, exit 3
boundary_semantics.direct_service_unknown_worker_error_acti: MlxService terminates immediately; a subsequent Rust API request is rejected as closed
boundary_semantics.explicit_shutdown_action: validate acknowledgement, sweep the original process group before leader reap, emit shutdown receipt, exit 0
boundary_semantics.unexpected_eof_action: immediately abort without waiting for the configured worker timeout, emit fatal stderr receipt, exit 2
boundary_semantics.path_policy: absolute existing direct model, Python, and runner paths; symlinks rejected

session_semantics.committed_prefix: complete prompt plus every token yielded by generate_step; the next predicted but not yet yielded token is not committed
session_semantics.changed_missing_or_branched_old_token_ac: reject before cache mutation; never silently fall back to fresh generation
session_semantics.eviction: explicit LRU eviction reported by the service receipt
session_semantics.post_mutation_failure: invalidate the entire affected session because Qwen3.5 Gated DeltaNet recurrent cache cannot be cloned or rolled back safely

tdd.initial_red: mlx_serve_command_parses_explicit_local_boundary initially failed to compile because Command had no MlxServe variant
p1_red: unknown_worker_error_code_is_fatal observed exit 2 because ordinary generate treated every Worker code as recoverable
explicit_shutdown_reaps_pipe_inheriting_descendants exceeded 750 ms because a descendant retained the pipes after its parent exited
bad_input_aborts_immediately_even_when_worker_ignores_shutdown exceeded 750 ms because EOF attempted graceful shutdown with a 3600-second configured timeout
follow-up review found MlxService::generate only terminated Boundary errors, so its direct API could continue after an unknown Worker code
tdd.green: all three P1 tracer-bullet tests and the full fake CLI regression pass

cli_subprocess_coverage: two generation requests start and load the fake worker once
exact session append, branch rejection, reset, failure invalidation, and recovery
malformed JSON, duplicate keys, unknown fields, and oversized lines fail closed
duplicate request ID and unexpected EOF exit nonzero and reap the worker
symlinked Python is rejected before worker start
unknown worker error codes are fatal rather than implicitly recoverable
valid shutdown kills pipe-inheriting descendants before leader reap
EOF and oversized input abort within 750 ms even when timeout is 3600 seconds and the worker ignores shutdown
tests.clippy: unavailable in the installed Rust toolchain

host_noise_observation.observation: one earlier parallel run hit pre-existing wall-clock startup/provider assertions under host contention; the final serial full binary suite passed 46 of 46 non-real tests

frozen_real_service_evidence.interpretation: correctness and candidate timing only; no speedup claim because the host had high background CPU load

limitations: the command is a serial local application boundary, not an HTTP, OpenAI-compatible, or SSE endpoint
sessions and duplicate-request-ID memory are process-local and disappear on shutdown
the 512 MiB cache limit is logical cache nbytes, not allocator reservations or total process RSS
Qwen3.5 recurrent cache cannot support safe trimming or branching with the pinned mlx-lm API
